environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed behind Envoy proxy sidecar (v1.28) with a custom Lua filter that performs RFC 3986 normalization on the redirect_uri query parameter before forwarding, and a secondary ext_authz filter calling an OPA policy bundle (rego v0.58) that evaluates redirect_uri against an exact-match allowlist after normalization. The OPA policy data document contains the canonical redirect URIs (not prefixes). Additionally, the Envoy route configuration sets 'normalize_path: true' and 'merge_slashes: true' on the route entry. The HSM (Luna Network HSM 7) holds all signing keys with partition policy requiring dual-control activation. Envoy listener binds 0.0.0.0:8443 and proxies to 127.0.0.1:8080 (app). No direct network path to app port exists (iptables DROP on INPUT for dport 8080 from non-loopback).

config.lua_filter: normalize redirect_uri per RFC 3986 (percent-decode unreserved, case-normalize scheme/host, remove dot segments, resolve path)
config.ext_authz_opa_policy: exact match of normalized redirect_uri against data.allowed_redirects set; denies if not in set
config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, partition with dual-control PED keys
config.tls_termination: Envoy with certificate from HSM-backed CA
